'''2007 Worlds Day 3 Justin Desai LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Deck title Don Desai, CIA operation. Line1 Plead scribbled; published Plead My Case / Sanity And Compassion (senate package). Suppression & Most Suppression → Projection Of A Skywalker; Lull & Jedi Knights → Jedi Presence (OCR).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Justin Desai]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Plead My Case To The Senate]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
